title: DEMO rate grids aligned with credit_conso.json
warning: Fictitious demo grids. Identifiers/name/tags/constraints taken from credit_conso.json; APRs come from synthetic rules and are not official SG/BFM rates. Do not confuse credit_conso.offres[].taux.taeg with the demo grid.
rates_are: Annual APR (as a percentage) for a simulation excluding optional insurance and assuming demo arrangement fees = 0 EUR. Where an official product provides for fees, apply the APR calculation correctly before real use.
calculation: For amortising loans with no fees and no deferral: monthly rate = (1+APR/100)^(1/12)-1; monthly payment = capital * i / (1-(1+i)^(-number_months)); if APR is 0, capital/number_months. Round and adjust the last instalment.

products.name: Expresso Loan
products.source_notes: Ceiling 75 000 EUR: demo convention, not a verified SG ceiling. Ceiling absent from the catalogue: amount_max_eur is only the bound of the demo rules.

products.name: Expresso Auto Loan
products.source_notes: Ceiling 75 000 EUR: demo convention; Franfinance publishes 4,89% for 15 000 EUR/48 months, but this is not the SG rate schedule. Ceiling absent from the catalogue: amount_max_eur is only the bound of the demo rules.

products.name: Alterna Revolving Credit
products.source_notes: Thresholds apply to the amount drawn, not to the authorised reserve. Term 1-120 months: demo technical bound, not an SG contractual term. Rate rules apply to the amount used (>=150 € for a transfer); revolving credit: do not automatically calculate it as an amortising loan with constant instalments.

regles_recommandation.vigilance: Always compare the total cost with an amortising personal loan.

products.amount_basis: amount_used (transfer >=150 €); authorised reserve >=1500 € separate from the amount used

products.name: Expresso Young Professional Loan
products.source_notes: SG advertises “from 5,55% fixed APR” without publishing the amount/term combinations; assignment of rates to brackets = fictitious.

products.name: Progressive Student Loan
products.source_notes: Deferral and staged drawdown must be simulated separately. Above 75 000 EUR, do not automatically apply the ordinary consumer credit usury check.

products.name: €1-a-day Driving Licence Loan
products.source_notes: Official 0% rate, repayment of 30 EUR/month except the last instalment; the 800/1000 EUR cases have a final instalment of 20/10 EUR respectively.

products.name: Compact Loan
products.source_notes: Ceiling 75 000 EUR = demo convention; consumer credit consolidation excluding mortgages. Ceiling absent from the catalogue: amount_max_eur is only the bound of the demo rules.

regles_recommandation.vigilance: A lower monthly payment may result from a longer term and increase the total cost of the loan.

rate_resolution: A rule applies if amount_min_eur <= amount <= amount_max_eur AND duration_min_months <= term <= duration_max_months. For Alterna, amount = usage and not the reserve ceiling. Refuse outside catalogue limits or when no rule exists; do not extrapolate.
